description: Two ground relation atoms are congruent relative to a finite term-pair relation when their arities and relation symbols agree and all corresponding arguments are related. Equality atoms do not meet this relation.
signature:

  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom L →
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom L → Prop
